Started to circulate well to sea water. Staged up pumps to 3000 l/min 78bar. Observed dirty fluid in returns. OIW reading is above 100ppm. No gas. After 50m3 pumped pulled 3m above combination wiper plug. Continued circulating. Shakers overflowed, reduced the rate to 2200l/min 56bar. Circulated additional 112 m3. Observed clear returns after total of 162 m3 pumped. OIW content less than 30 ppm. Stopped pumps. Installed pump in sub w/ LT valve.

Performed pre-job meeting to place pump balance cement plug
Pumped 20m3 wash pill with mud pumps, 2700l/min 79bar. Applied 20 bar behind IBOP, verified line up

Balanced cement plug m 2416 m mixed and pumped 9,4 m3 of 1,9 SG cement slurry, 600 l/min. Displaced the cement to the rig floor with 2900 l of drill water. Zeroed volume counters. Displaced the cement with 37 m3 strokes) of SW, 2900 l/min/ 51 bar. Pulled out of cement to 2416m at 4 min/stand. Theoretical TOC 2416 m MD.
Installed sponge ball. Pumped 10m3 hi-vis at 2400l/min 43 bar. Circulated out cement at MAX of 3400 l/min/ 116 bar. Diverted returns overboard. L/d pup joint and r/b 1x stand to 2372m. Meanwhile WOC
Performed pre-job meeting to wash BOP w/ jetting tool. Meanwhile WOC
Installed closed FOSV and BOP wash tool, made 10x passes in BOP and well head area at 1500 LPM 12 bar, operated rams and annular once. L/d BOP wash tool. Meanwhile WOC
Performed pre-job meeting to l/d DP. Meanwhile WOC
Installed pipe deck rollers. POOH and l/d singles of 5,5in DP from 2372m to 2052m. Meanwhile WOC
Removed DP slips and installed master bushing. Meanwhile WOC
Performed pre-job meeting to r/u casing tong. Meanwhile WOC
R/u casing tong and broke off swedge from top of tubing string. Meanwhile WOC
R/d casing tong. Meanwhile WOC
P/u spear BHA, set in catch position and engaged into tubing string, RIH to 2084m. Meanwhile WOC
RIH w/ 5,5in DP from 2084m to 2365m. Average tripping speed 612 m/hour. Performed kick drill. Meanwhile WOC
Performed maintenance on TDS. Cleared chiksans from wellhead. Worked on PMS on drilling equipment. Tested back up BX elevators, good test. Meanwhile WOC
Cleaned in moonpool. Worked to service both prss and TDS. Installed drill pipe slips. Meanwhile WOC
